property_summary: After Collect(uint256) is called, MinSum must remain at its value set by SetMinSum when intitalized is false.
After Collect(uint256) is called, MinSum must be set only if intitalized is true.
After calling Collect, the MinSum state variable should never change from its initial value of 0.
After calling Collect, the MinSum state variable should remain unchanged from its initial value.
After Collect(0) is called, MinSum must equal 0 (the initial value set in deployment).
MinSum remains unchanged after a call to Collect when the caller's balance is zero.
After any call to Collect, the MinSum state variable retains its original value set during initialization.
Setting MinSum to zero is allowed before initialization, but after initialization Collect ignores the zero value and keeps MinSum unchanged.
After any call to Collect, MinSum must be the value it was set to (not zero) if initialized is true.
The MinSum value after any Collect call must be the last value set by SetMinSum before initialization.
After initialization, calling Collect never changes MinSum from the last value set by SetMinSum.
After initialization, calling Collect never changes MinSum from the last value set by SetMinSum.
After a call to Collect, the value of MinSum remains unchanged from its initial set value when initialized is false.
After any call to Collect, MinSum equals its value after the last SetMinSum call, regardless of whether initialized is true.
After any call to Collect, MinSum is less than or equal to the last explicitly set value from SetMinSum when the contract was not initialized.
After Collect(uint256) is called, MinSum equals the value set by the last SetMinSum(uint256) call that occurred before initialization.
After any successful call to Collect(uint256) from any address, the MinSum state variable equals the value set by the last SetMinSum(uint256) call that occurred before initialization.
After a successful Collect call, the MinSum state variable must never decrease.
After a Collect call that reverts, MinSum must remain unchanged.
After every Collect call (whether it succeeds or reverts), the MinSum value must be equal to its value before the call.
After a Collect call, the MinSum state variable must retain its value from before the call.
After a Collect call, the MinSum state variable must be equal to its value before the call.
After calling Collect(uint256), the LogFile address is unchanged from its initial value.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect, the value of c.MinSum() remains the same as its initial value (0).

After any sequence of calls, the address of LogFile as returned by c.Log() is always the zero address initially, and remains zero if SetLogFile is never called; but after a Put call, the buggy version breaks because Log is never set.
After a call to Collect, the LogFile address returned by c.Log() is always the address set by the last call to SetLogFile, which is the zero address if SetLogFile was never called.
After Collect, if SetLogFile was never called, the LogFile address remains the zero address (from initialization).
After Collect is called with any amount, the contract's Log address remains zero.
After any call to Collect(uint256), the Log address stored in the contract is the same as the Log address before the call.
After any call to Collect(uint256), the contract's Log address equals the address that was passed to SetLogFile.
After any call to Collect(uint256), the Log contract's address is equal to the contract's own address.
After any call to Collect(uint256), the Log contract's address is the same as the address passed to SetLogFile.
After a successful Collect call, the intitalized state variable remains false.
After any successful Collect call, the intitalized state variable remains false.
Calling Collect with any positive amount never sets intitalized to true
After a successful Collect call, the intitalized state variable is unchanged from before the call.
After Collect reverts, intitalized remains false.
After calling Collect with the maximum amount, the uintitialized state variable remains false.
After calling Collect(uint256) with _am greater than 0 and less than or equal to the caller's balance, the initializer flag remains false.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect, the intitalized state variable is unchanged (stays false initially).
After calling Collect with any _am, the intitalized flag should remain false if Initialized() was never called.
After calling Collect with any amount, the intitalized state variable retains its value from before the call (i.e., Collect does not set intitalized to true).
After a Collect call that fails due to insufficient balance, the reentrancy lock is released so subsequent calls can proceed.
The nonReentrant modifier should release the lock after a Collect call completes, even if the call reverts due to insufficient balance, so that subsequent calls can proceed.

After any Collect call, whether it succeeds or reverts, P.Initialized() remains false, while with the bug it becomes true after a successful Collect because the mutex is never released, allowing Initialized() to be called before the lock is released.

After a Collect call that fails due to insufficient balance, the Initialized() state variable remains false in the reference, but with the bug it becomes true because the lock is never released and a subsequent call to Initialized() succeeds.
After a Collect call that reverts due to insufficient balance, the nonReentrant lock is released so that a subsequent call to Put can execute without reverting.
After calling Collect(uint256) with any amount, the Initialized() state variable should remain unchanged (false) if it was false before the call.
After calling Collect(uint256), the Initialized() state variable should remain unchanged from its initial value (false).
After any call to Collect(uint256), the Initialized() state variable must always be false.
After calling Collect(uint256), the Initialized() state variable should remain unchanged from its initial value (false).

After a call to Collect(uint256), the value of the Initialized() getter must be the same as the value of the intitalized state variable before the call (as observable through the Initialized() getter).
The caller's balance after Collect should never exceed the original balance plus the amount sent in Put.
After Collect reverts, the balance of the caller's account in the contract should not have decreased.
After a call to Collect, the caller's account balance in the contract never exceeds the sum of all previous successful Put amounts.
After Collect returns (even revert), the balance of the caller in the contract does not increase.
After a Collect call, the total Ether balance of the contract (address(this).balance) never increases beyond the sum of all Put msg.value amounts that succeeded.
Collect reverts if the caller's balance is less than the requested amount or less than MinSum.
Collect does not decrease the caller's balance when the caller's balance is less than MinSum.

When Collect succeeds, the caller's balance decreases exactly by the amount requested only if the caller's balance was at least MinSum and at least the requested amount before the call; otherwise, the balance does not change.

After Collect, the caller's balance decreases exactly by the amount requested only when the caller's balance was at least MinSum and at least the requested amount before the call; otherwise, the balance does not change.

After Collect, the caller's balance decreases by the requested amount only if the caller's balance was at least MinSum and at least the requested amount before the call; otherwise, the balance does not change.
